title: Raycast community
description: A two-tone heading, two ringed community cards side by side (stacked on phones) each with an icon, name, a mono member count, a grey sentence and a bold link with an arrow, over a blurred crimson art slot that spills behind them; below, a centred row of 230×129 video thumbnails with titles, faded at both edges and scrollable, then a grey note and a channel link.
notes: backdrop and thumbnails are media slots (placeholders when empty)
the video row starts centred and can be scrolled sideways; needs JavaScript only for the centring
